scenario: 今天的生成式赛道，推荐和搜索两边各有几篇。推荐这边，SIDRec 让 Semantic ID 的构造跟着点击预测一起训练，GCB 用 Semantic ID 一次预测用户接下来的多步行为，RecGroupMemory 让人群记忆随前一天的反馈更新，同时不动观测记录。搜索这边，几篇论文都在问生成式引擎到底偏向谁，大品牌天然占便宜，改写文案的收益换到真实网页上也不稳。

papers.title: RecGroupMemory: Feedback-Aware Cohort Memory for E-Commerce Recommendation
papers.authors: Wendong Zhang, Weipeng Huang, Zhixin Ma, Bin Zhang, Dimin Wang
papers.abstract: Cohort memory can support LLM-based recommendation planning through group-level user profiles and advice. As outcome feedback becomes available, this guidance may need to be updated while preserving the underlying observations. We present RecGroupMemory, a workflow that provides this memory to an orchestration LLM and separates memory construction from feedback-based revision. It uses feedback from the previous day to revise decision guidance, while validation checks keep selected source values unchanged. Online comparisons were conducted among Taobao users with low purchasing power selected by the business team. Relative to a no-memory baseline, memory without feedback and memory with feedback showed increases of 1.58% and 1.78%, respectively, in the number of guided transaction users.
papers.summary: 用大模型规划推荐流程时，如果希望它参考某类人群过去表现的记忆，就有一个难题：第二天有了新的成交反馈，建议要改，但人群定义、观察窗口和统计数字这些记录不能被模型顺手改掉。RecGroupMemory 把记忆拆成两层，一层是只读的观测记录，一层是画像和建议，前一天的反馈只允许改后一层，改完还要校验观测记录没变，不通过就保留原记录。在电商平台购买力较低、由业务方选定的用户上做线上对比，只加人群记忆的一组，成交用户数比无记忆基线多 1.58%；再加反馈修订的另一组，比它自己的无记忆基线多 1.78%。

papers.title: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data Matter: Utility and Demographic Sensitivity in LLM-Based Recommendation
papers.authors: Furkan Yasir Goksu, Yaren Yilmaz, Sule Gunduz Oguducu
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. Experiments on MovieLens-1M show that the catalog-constrained pipeline eliminates out-of-catalog items and ensures complete ten-item outputs, while prompt augmentation improves prompt consistency and utility. Original MovieLens titles increase HR@10 from 10.67% to 12.47% and Coverage@10 from 41.36% to 47.88%. Fairness-related effects are attribute-dependent: age balancing and knowledge enrichment reduce selected group-level utility gaps while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduces utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Overall, preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data should be evaluated jointly in terms of utility, output behavior, and demographic sensitivity.
papers.summary: 用大模型直接生成推荐列表时，微调数据怎么预处理，会明显影响效果。作者在 MovieLens-1M 上微调 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 做了对比。只是电影标题的写法就有影响。把末尾的冠词挪回开头（比如 Matrix, The 改成 The Matrix），HR@10 是 10.67%；保留数据集原样的写法，是 12.47%。想让各人群结果更均衡，效果也因属性而异：按年龄平衡训练数据，年龄组之间的效果差距缩小，总体效果几乎不变；按性别平衡，总体效果下降，男女两组之间的效果差距也没有缩小。预处理选择要同时看效果、输出行为和对人群的敏感度。

papers.title: Generative Chain of Behavior for User Trajectory Prediction
papers.authors: Chengkai Huang, Xiaodi Chen, Hongtao Huang, Quan Z. Sheng, Lina Yao
papers.abstract: Modeling long-term user behavior trajectories is essential for understanding evolving preferences and enabling proactive recommendations. However, most sequential recommenders focus on next-item prediction, overlooking dependencies across multiple future actions. We propose Generative Chain of Behavior (GCB), a generative framework that models user interactions as an autoregressive chain of semantic behaviors over multiple future steps. GCB first encodes items into semantic IDs via RQ-VAE with k-means refinement, forming a discrete latent space that preserves semantic proximity. On top of this space, a transformer-based autoregressive generator predicts multi-step future behaviors conditioned on user history, capturing long-horizon intent transitions and generating coherent trajectories. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that GCB achieves strong multi-step prediction performance while generating coherent long-horizon behavior trajectories. papers.summary: 大多数序列推荐模型只预测用户的下一个物品，但用户行为是一串有先后关系的动作，后面几步会受前面几步影响。论文提出的 GCB 直接预测接下来的多步行为。它先把每个物品编成由 4 个离散码组成的 Semantic ID：前三个码由 RQ-VAE 逐级量化物品向量得到，各级码本先用 k-means 聚类初始化，以免码本塌缩，第四个码只用来区分撞码的物品，所以语义相近的物品前缀也相近。再用 Transformer 自回归地一个一个生成未来几步的 Semantic ID，让后一步以前面已生成的步骤为条件。在 Amazon 的 Beauty 和 Cell Phones 两个数据集上，GCB 在多数多步指标上最好或接近最好，Cell Phones 上优势最明显；预测得越远，所有模型的效果都下降。

papers.title: SIDRec: End-to-End Semantic ID Representation and Modeling for Recommendation
papers.authors: Zhuohang Jiang, Yongsen Pan, Pangjing Wu, Zihuai Zhao, Zheng Hu, Yuxin Chen
papers.abstract: Semantic IDs (SIDs) have emerged as a promising approach for discriminative recommendation by encoding continuous item rep- resentations into compact discrete identifiers. However, existing SID-based methods face two fundamental limitations: semantic mis- match between content semantics and collaborative preferences, and objective mismatch between SID construction and downstream recommendation optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SIDRec, an end-to-end recommendation-aware SID learn- ing framework that jointly models content and collaborative in- formation while aligning SID construction with recommendation objectives. Specifically, SIDRec introduces a self-updating fusion mechanism that explicitly integrates pretrained content represen- tations with collaborative embeddings initialized from a trained recommendation model, enabling preference-aware semantic mod- eling. Furthermore, SIDRec employs an MMoE-inspired joint opti- mization mechanism with shared experts and task-specific gates, allowing recommendation supervision to directly guide differen- tiable quantization and produce task-adaptive discrete representa- tions. Extensive experiments on three public benchmark datasets demonstrate that SIDRec consistently outperforms all competing methods across both AUC and GAUC, achieving up to 5.15% relative improvements over the strongest baselines. Further ablation stud- ies validate the effectiveness and complementarity of collaborative semantic modeling and end-to-end SID optimization.
papers.summary: Semantic ID（SID）通常先用商品的内容向量离线量化出来，训练排序模型时就固定了，这带来两个问题。一是内容相近的商品，用户偏好可能不同，SID 里没有这类协同信息。二是 SID 怎么划分，从来没有被点击预测的目标训练过。SIDRec 的做法是，用训练好的排序模型的 embedding 初始化协同表示并随训练更新，和内容表征融合；同时让量化过程能接收梯度：前向仍取离散的 SID，反向用平滑的概率近似，点击预测的梯度就能传回量化器，更新它的参数，从而改变商品的 SID 分配。在三个公开数据集上，AUC 和 GAUC 都超过所有对比方法，相对最强基线最多提升 5.15%。把融合和端到端优化两部分都去掉，AUC 下降 7.19%。

papers.title: The Popular Get More Popular: Auditing Brand Bias in Generative Search
papers.authors: Giorgio Monaco, Jacopo Lenti, Francesco Pierri
papers.abstract: The shift from traditional to generative search has fundamentally transformed online product discovery. Because conversational recommendations synthesize choices into a few direct answers, subtle systemic preferences toward specific providers can exert profound commercial impacts. In this work, we audit this phenomenon through two distinct dimensions: (i) brand popularity bias, the systematic preference for market-dominant entities over long-tail alternatives, and (ii) brand familiarity bias, the ranking advantage an entity encoded in an LLM's parametric memory holds over an unfamiliar competitor. First, evaluating commercial queries across major engines, we observe persistent brand popularity bias: dominant brands in the top quintile are cited 1.4x to 2.8x more frequently than the average brand within a sample of 1,176 top market players, already present in parametric memory that external web retrieval fails to mitigate. Second, through controlled in-context experiments holding product attributes constant, we find that substituting authentic brand signatures with unfamiliar ones significantly degrades recommendation rank. Conversely, fact-preserving content rewrites yield negligible ranking gains. Taken together, our findings demonstrate that generative search engines reinforce a ``rich-get-richer'' dynamic by favoring established market leaders and imposing a parametric barrier to entry that standard content optimization cannot overcome.
papers.summary: 让生成式搜索推荐商品，大牌是不是天然占便宜？作者查了三个线上的生成式搜索引擎，在上千个品牌里，销量和知名度排在前五分之一的品牌，被提到和被引用的次数是平均品牌的 1.4 到 2.8 倍，而且开了联网搜索也没有缓解。接着做了一个对照实验，让四个模型给五个商品页排序，其中一页的商品信息不变，只把落款的品牌换成虚构的，它的名次平均掉 0.44 位。把这一页的文字按三种常见的生成式引擎优化方法改写，名次只变动约 0.02 位。对新品牌来说，改写文案帮不上多少忙，模型已经记住的品牌印象才起作用。

papers.title: Learning What to Ask and What to Believe: Distilling a Variational Bayesian Agent into Language Models
papers.authors: Baichuan Li, Yanling Chang, Alfredo Garcia
papers.abstract: Interactive tasks such as eliciting a user's preferences or diagnosing a hidden mechanism require an agent to track its uncertainty over a latent state, ask informative questions and act on the answers. Language models have no explicit mechanism for this, whereas Bayesian information seeking provides one through posterior inference and expected information gain (EIG), and we ask whether it can be distilled into an 8B language model. Our teacher, a lightweight Bayesian agent with a sequential variational belief and EIG query selection, matches or approaches exact and particle references on three task families. We generate synthetic interactions with the teacher on episodes disjoint from the benchmark and fine-tune \Student{} to reproduce its queries and its belief state as a structured scratchpad. On three Multi-Turn Puzzles tasks the student raises Circuit Decoding from 0.00 to 0.93 success, lowers the normalized rank of the recommended film from 0.50 to 0.10 and cuts word guessing from 32 to 3.4 attempts, exceeding the strongest reported language models on the two comparable tasks. Exposing the belief state closes much of the gap where the decision is an implicit computation rather than a read-out of the interaction; in matched teacher contrasts, EIG supervision consistently outperforms random querying, whereas greater inference fidelity does not uniformly improve the distilled student; a 70B language-model teacher does not match the Bayesian teacher in downstream student performance, and the learned skill does not transfer to an unseen task family. Variational Bayesian information seeking can thus be amortized into a language model by transferring the belief state that drives its questions and decisions.
papers.summary: 让大模型通过多轮提问查明一个看不见的答案，比如问几个问题猜出用户喜欢哪部电影，它往往不会选最有信息量的问题，也不会记住自己已经排除了什么。作者先做了一个贝叶斯老师，每轮维护对答案的概率判断，再选预期信息增益最大的问题来问。然后用老师生成的对话微调 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，让它模仿老师的提问，并把概率判断写成草稿再决定下一步。在三个谜题任务上，破解电路的成功率从 0.00 升到 0.93。猜词平均尝试次数从 32 降到 3.4。换成 70B 的语言模型当老师不如贝叶斯老师，学到的本领也迁移不到没见过的任务类型。

papers.title: Do GEO Gains Survive the Live Web? Evaluating In-the-Wild Visibility Gains of Generative Engine Optimization via LIVE-GEO
papers.authors: Runze Kong, Haibo Jin, Xucheng Yu, Xiaoqi Wang, Huimin Zeng, Haohan Wang
papers.abstract: Generative engine optimization (GEO) rewrites web content so that LLM-based search systems, also termed generative engines (GEs), rank it higher in their answers and recommendations. However, existing GEO evaluations typically rely on directly supplied text or controlled retrieval pipelines, and whether GEO gains survive the live Web remains unclear, leaving a gap in understanding how GEO strategies affect the visibility of live webpages when accessed and ranked by GEs. To address this gap, we introduce LIVE-GEO, a benchmark for Live, In-the-wild Visibility Evaluation for GEO. LIVE-GEO publishes GEO-rewritten products as live webpages. We use LIVE-GEO to evaluate five existing GEO strategies (CORE, C-SEO, E-GEO, AgenticGEO, and Statistics Addition), applying them to the product descriptions and reviews of 80 fictional brands across 18 product families. We run experiments on three GEs (ChatGPT with GPT-6, Gemini 3.6 Thinking, and Grok in Expert mode), four direct-text API evaluators (GPT-4o, DeepSeek, Kimi, and Claude), and a direct-text local evaluator (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct). With frozen $\pm0.2\%$ prices, most direct-text evaluators and GEs receiving product URLs give CORE the highest Top-1 rate, reaching 66.3%-76.3% on the GEs, yet other strategies vary in relative performance, and the GEs select the same top product for only 48.8%-66.3% of brands. We also find that ChatGPT is sensitive to the order of candidate URLs: CORE's Top-1 rate is 73.8% and 93.8% under two opposite fixed orders, and the randomized order used by LIVE-GEO yields 82.5%, between the two. In the numerical-faithfulness check, the JEV verifier agrees with the reference labels on 90.7% of 194 numerical benchmark cases and with human judgments on all 50 sampled descriptions, and it flags 86 of the 400 rewritten descriptions, including all 80 Statistics Addition descriptions.
papers.summary: 生成式引擎优化（GEO）是改写网页文案，让大模型搜索把它排得更靠前。已有评测多是直接把文字塞给模型，在真实网页上这些收益还在不在，没人确认过。LIVE-GEO 把改写后的商品页真正发布成线上网页，让三个商用生成式引擎自己打开网页，在一批虚构品牌各自的六个版本里排名次，这六个版本是原始文案和五种已有 GEO 策略改写出的五份。结果没有一个策略稳赢：同一个品牌，三个引擎选出同一个第一名的比例只有约一半到三分之二。ChatGPT 还受候选链接顺序影响，同一个策略的 Top-1 率在两种相反的固定顺序下分别是 73.8% 和 93.8%。
